title: commodity-input-method — manual vs CSV routing

notes: First command is the BASELINE run before any edit (red baseline = stop and report); second is the same script after the change. This increment OPENS the commodities feature group, flow section, task row and hub spoke 3 with its first page; pp-023..pp-027 grow them. Recipe: cheat-sheet §3 (add-a-section — group folder shape, section+row+hub steps) with §2 (add-a-page) for the page itself. Exemplars verified live this session: features/import-reason/controller.js + evaluation.js (single-radio collecting page — transpose almost verbatim), features/transport/ (group folder shape: shared page.js/evaluation.js/copy/, per-page subdirs <name>/<name>.controller.js|.njk, specs in e2e/), features/hub/controller.js:33 (GROUPS shape). Rulings applied: c-013 (one canonical question, visible H1 wording wins, legend-as-heading), FD-8 (persisted obligation, NOT flow-only), c-018 (single Joi-voice validation string), c-004/c-014 house error rendering ('There is a problem' + 'Error:' prefix — deliberately NOT the legacy 'Please fix the following errors'/prefix-less errorSpan defects), no-display-logic-in-model (MANUAL|CSV vocabulary in controller+copy, obligation is pure data). Decisions taken headless: (1) radio values are the normalised backend enum MANUAL|CSV submitted directly (mirrors reasonForImport; legacy lowercase 'manual'/'csv' wire values not carried); (2) both options render (spec-confirmed two-option surface, backend enum accepts both) but routing does not branch — CSV selections continue down the manual spine until pp-042 lands the branch; (3) the legacy destructive-switch warning banner, CSV-side sticky pre-selection quirks (definedness trap) and the switch-time PATCH mutation are ALL deferred to pp-042 — the page spec itself marks them design questions, and with one branch there is nothing to destroy; (4) caption kept as the spec's 'Description of the goods'; (5) no check-answers work — the check-answers feature is pp-038's, which decides whether a routing choice merits a row; (6) legacy etag/optimistic-concurrency hidden field not carried (house model is last-write-wins, Open Q 3 ruling in §6.2). Not platform-touching (set files + set-cloned contract table only), so the two-sided sibling-safety check is not required; npm test still covers L1 composition, dispatch, copy-convention/parity and reachability.
openQuestions: Should check-answers (pp-038) surface the input-method choice as a reviewable row, given it is a routing/entry-mechanism choice rather than consignment data? Deferred to pp-038's planner.
